$comment: Provider pack: markitdown privacy-hardened local MCP (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX -> Markdown). Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack markitdown. --enable-pack markitdown now also installs the Python launcher (install_local_mcp_launchers via run_pack_merger; the Docker image bakes it via pip install in the Dockerfile). Sets a root permissions rule {action: "markitdown*", effect: "allow"} so the rule-merge flips the source-config deny in place.
